title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 530 Claremont Avenue in Ashland, Ohio, as the "Bill Harris Post Office".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 530 Claremont Avenue in Ashland, Ohio, as the "Bill Harris Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named a post office building in Ashland, Ohio, the "Bill Harris Post Office."
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 530 Claremont Avenue in Ashland, Ohio, to honor a person named Bill Harris. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, or postal rules.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on December 6, 2018.
